question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.**

The __**malice**__ he developed for all caused a lot of damage.
solution:
The correct answer is 'sympathy'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Malice is a noun that means **the desire to harm someone; ill will.**
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• avarice - extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
 
• grace - smoothness and elegance of movement.
 
• sympathy - feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune.
 
• oppression - prolonged cruel or unjust treatment or exercise of authority.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that sympathy is the correct antonym for the word malice.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
